statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has a diagnosis of chest pain (R42)
CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained or submitted prior to the service date
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
